summary: President Trump announced U.S. control of the Strait of Hormuz, claiming 28 ships were destroyed and threatening to rename it 'Trump Strait,' while Iran's Rouhani vowed not to surrender to American 'conspiracy.' Simultaneously, Reuters reported that Iran warned the U.S. it would respond forcefully if Israel attacks the Al-Taher hill in southern Lebanon, where Hezbollah and IRGC Quds Force members are surrounded. The situation remains highly volatile with ongoing Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon, and Yemeni naval exercises in the Red Sea.

sections.executive_summary: President Trump announced U.S. control of the Strait of Hormuz, claiming 28 ships were destroyed and threatening to rename it 'Trump Strait,' while Iran's Rouhani vowed not to surrender to American 'conspiracy.' Simultaneously, Reuters reported that Iran warned the U.S. it would respond forcefully if Israel attacks the Al-Taher hill in southern Lebanon, where Hezbollah and IRGC Quds Force members are surrounded. The situation remains highly volatile with ongoing Israeli operations in Gaza and Lebanon, and Yemeni naval exercises in the Red Sea.

points: Iranian President Rouhani stated in a meeting with provincial governors that Iran will not surrender to Trump's recent conspiracy, calling political duality baseless and incorrect. He emphasized that war must end honorably and that all the nation must stand behind the armed forces and negotiators. Rouhani also noted that the leadership stood up to America and sacrificed their lives for the country's independence and greatness, and that the people showed appreciation in the funeral processions both domestically and in Iraq. (Source: @SharghDaily/181654)

Three Iranian army pilots were killed in a U.S. military attack on Iran two nights prior. The martyrs were identified as Majtaba Baqeri and Hamed Okati from the Navy, and Hossein Mahdavian from the Air Force. This comes as part of ongoing U.S. military operations against Iranian targets. (Source: @SharghDaily/181655)

Iran reported that eight members of the Revolutionary Guards and Basij forces were killed in a U.S. strike in the city of Jahrom in Fars province, including a bulldozer operator. The death toll from the nighttime attack on the Revolutionary Guards rose to eight, indicating the intensity of the American military campaign against Iranian paramilitary structures. (Source: @asafroz/53018)

President Trump claimed that Iran was two weeks away from acquiring a nuclear weapon before the current conflict, stating that if Iran had possessed such a weapon, Israel and the Middle East would have been destroyed, and Iranian leaders would have attacked U.S. cities. Trump described the Iranian regime as 'crazy' and used this narrative to justify the U.S. military campaign. (Source: @VahidOnline/78191)

Prime Minister Netanyahu stated in an interview with I24NEWS that Israel has not finished the job and all its systems, under his leadership, are operating to bring down the Iranian regime and defeat it. This indicates a continued Israeli military posture focused on regime change in Iran. (Source: @inon_yttach/10004)

Defense Minister Israel Katz warned that an Iranian attack on Israel would remove all restrictions, and that Israel would target even energy infrastructure in response. This statement was made amid rising tensions and threats of Iranian retaliation for ongoing Israeli and U.S. operations. (Source: @kianmeli1/91477)

IDF forces in the southern Gaza Strip identified a terrorist who crossed the yellow line and approached Israeli forces in a manner constituting an immediate threat. The Air Force attacked and eliminated the terrorist, and IDF forces in the Southern Command remain deployed in accordance with the agreement to remove any immediate threat. (Source: @New_security8200/203585)

IDF forces secured the entry of Shin Bet police and a civilian to the village of Al-Mu'ayir in the Benjamin brigade to retrieve livestock belonging to Israeli citizens found in the village area. During the operation, terrorists threw stones and blocks at the force, and the IDF responded with fire at central instigators to remove the threat, resulting in wounds. (Source: @New_security8200/203583)

Israel released a Lebanese prisoner, Al-Kamal Al-A'azi (age 20), to the Lebanese army via the Red Cross as a goodwill gesture. The prisoner, who disappeared in October 2025 in the Ein Eta-Headia area after going out for sports, was reportedly kidnapped and transferred to Israel. (Source: @N12chat/224804; @lelotsenzura/94298)

IDF forces in the southern Gaza Strip identified and eliminated a terrorist who crossed the yellow line and approached Israeli forces in a way that constituted an immediate threat. The Air Force conducted the strike, and the Southern Command continues to operate to remove any immediate threat in accordance with the agreement. (Source: @New_security8200/203585)

IDF forces in the Benjamin sector (West Bank) secured the entry of Shin Bet police and a civilian to the village of Al-Mu'ayir to retrieve livestock belonging to Israeli citizens. During the operation, terrorists threw stones and blocks, and the IDF responded with fire at central instigators, resulting in wounds. The circumstances are under investigation. (Source: @New_security8200/203583)

A military exercise was scheduled to take place in the Efraim and Menashe sectors from morning until afternoon, with no security threat expected. The exercise involved audible movement of security forces in the area. (Source: @idf_telegram/25035)

According to Reuters, Iran warned the U.S. that it would respond forcefully if Israel attempts to attack the Al-Taher hill in southern Lebanon, where Hezbollah forces are surrounded. At least 12 members of the IRGC Quds Force, including two senior officials, are present alongside Hezbollah and facing very difficult conditions. Israel has increased offensive operations to capture tunnels and kill or capture these personnel. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80249)

The U.S. monitored the movement of Revolutionary Guards members from Iran into Lebanon, with some Lebanese security apparatus members suspected of involvement in issuing passports to Iranian operatives. Passage of Iranians using Lebanese documents is being checked at Beirut airport and at land border crossings. Loopholes in the registration of deaths in the Hezbollah environment are used as a means to bring Iranians into Lebanon. (Source: @shin_persian/9418)

Israel transferred a Lebanese prisoner, Al-Kamal Al-A'azi (age 20), to the Lebanese army via the Red Cross as a goodwill gesture. The prisoner disappeared in October 2025 in the Ein Eta-Headia area after going out for sports, and was reportedly kidnapped and transferred to Israel. He is undergoing medical examinations. (Source: @N12chat/224804; @lelotsenzura/94298)

A Lebanese Red Alert service announced that volunteers from across Lebanon are working around the clock to deliver alerts to protect citizens, relying on open sources and user reports. The service requested donations to continue uninterrupted operations. (Source: @redlinkleb/40361)

The Iraqi Al Taif bank, which was infamous for involvement in IRGC financial operations including cash smuggling, has gone bankrupt. The Iraqi Central Bank has placed Al Taif under guardianship, marking a significant blow to Iranian financial networks in Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/9431)

Three mujahideen were sentenced to 15 years in prison after their attack on the French base in Kirkuk province with Katyusha rockets during the Islamic Republic's war against the United States. This historical sentencing reflects ongoing judicial actions related to past attacks on foreign military presence in Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89286)

President Trump announced that the U.S. now controls the Strait of Hormuz, claiming that 28 ships were destroyed the previous night. He threatened to rename the strait 'Trump Strait' and stated that it would be 'hotter' than ever before, like America itself. (Source: @VahidOnline/78191)

Unknown explosions were heard near the Strait of Hormuz, adding to the tension in the strategic waterway. The incident occurred amid the ongoing U.S.-Iran conflict and Trump's claims of control over the strait. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89254)

Yemen's Supreme Political Council announced that the country's naval units are conducting a military exercise in the Red Sea in anticipation of U.S.-Israeli aggression against the Arab Peninsula nation. This indicates continued Yemeni alignment with Iran and preparation for potential conflict in the Red Sea region. (Source: @presstv/205360)

Yemeni armed forces targeted Saudi gatherings and vehicles in several fronts using a Jaloom drone, indicating ongoing cross-border hostilities between Yemen and Saudi Arabia in the context of the broader regional conflict. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388552)
U.S. oil prices fell below $90 per barrel again, with Brent crude reaching $94.39, reflecting the impact of the ongoing conflict in Iran on global energy markets. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80247)

sections.threat_assessment: The situation is highly volatile with the U.S. claiming control of the Strait of Hormuz and Iran vowing not to surrender, creating a high risk of escalation in the Gulf. The convergence of Israeli operations against Hezbollah and IRGC elements in southern Lebanon, coupled with Iran's warning of a forceful response, suggests a potential multi-front conflict. The U.S. deployment of Tomahawk missiles in Norway and Yemeni naval exercises in the Red Sea indicate that the conflict is expanding beyond the immediate Middle East theater, with global implications for energy security and regional stability.
sections.regional_response: Iran has responded with defiance, with Rouhani vowing not to surrender and calling for national unity behind the armed forces. Israel has taken a hardline stance, with Netanyahu declaring the mission to bring down the Iranian regime is unfinished and Katz warning of unrestricted retaliation against Iranian aggression. The Lebanese government and Hezbollah are caught in the middle, with the release of a Lebanese prisoner as a goodwill gesture indicating some diplomatic efforts to manage tensions, while the U.S. monitors Iranian infiltration via Lebanese documents.
